Final categorization: OK  
(Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that explicitly implements national-scale (Slovakia) spatial modeling of land use/land cover (LULC) change with a primary focus on future prediction. It develops and quantitatively compares five distinct future scenarios (including TREND, A1, A2, B1, B2) up to 2040 using the CLUmondo framework and boosted regression trees. The study provides mapped LULC projections (e.g., Figs. 6–7), reports quantitative accuracy metrics (AUC > 0.73, COR > 0.41 for past models; AUC 0.89–0.93 for future suitability models), and analyzes spatial determinants driving transitions such as urbanisation, agricultural intensification/extensification, and afforestation. All core inclusion criteria are met: national-scale implementation, primary LULC prediction focus, ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparison, spatial modeling with accuracy metrics, and mapped outputs. None of the exclusion criteria apply.)
